title: Understanding the Problem
text: You need to replace any word in the Series that matches the pattern stored in 'pat' with the word 'dog'.

title: Using Pandas String Methods
text: Pandas Series objects have a 'str' accessor that allows you to apply string methods to each element in the Series.

title: Using the Replace Method
text: The 'replace' method can be used to replace occurrences of a pattern with a specified string. It takes the pattern to match, the replacement string, and a 'regex' parameter to specify if the pattern is a regular expression.

title: Constructing the Replace Function
text: Write the line of code using the 'replace' method to replace words matching 'pat' with 'dog'.
